factors.name: size_relative_to_parent
factors.rationale: Small market cap relative to parent causes parent institutional holders to dump shares due to minimum position size rules.

factors.name: initial_weakness
factors.rationale: Share price weakness in first weeks confirms forced institutional selling is underway, depressing price below fundamental value.

factors.name: insider_buying
factors.rationale: Form 4 transaction code P (open-market purchase) proves insiders are investing personal capital at market prices.

factors.name: analyst_neglect
factors.rationale: Few or zero Wall Street analysts covering the spinoff ensures low market attention and pricing inefficiency.

factors.name: absolute_market_cap
factors.rationale: Small absolute capitalization falls below institutional thresholds, generating structural mispricing.
